title: Save any link instantly
description: Paste a URL or press Ctrl+V anywhere in the app. Purl fetches the title, favicon, and thumbnail automatically.

title: Keep your files too
description: Upload PDFs and audio right next to your links, so everything lives in one place.

title: Connect any AI Agent
description: Plug Purl into Claude, Cursor, or VS Code over MCP. Your agent can save to and browse your library directly.

title: Build with the API
description: Save, list, and manage your links from your own scripts and tools with a simple REST API and a Purl key.
